name: agent-kit
description: Beau Lyddon's portable skills and plugins for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, pi, OpenCode and other Agent Skills / Agent Plugins clients.

plugins.name: essentials
plugins.description: Everyday engineering skills that work in any agent, for commit messages and cross-tool session handoffs.

plugins.name: eng-leadership
plugins.description: Skills for engineering leaders, for design/RFC reviews and structured interview kits.

plugins.name: research-tools
plugins.description: Up-to-date library and API documentation lookup via the Context7 MCP server, with a no-MCP fallback.

plugins.name: principles
plugins.description: Twenty-four named engineering principles (prove it works, fix root causes, subtract before you add, build the lever, and more) that steer how agents design, build and verify, plus a benchmark checklist. One skill with one file per principle.

plugins.name: bstack
plugins.description: Beau's rigorous agent workflow. beau-mode routes each task to a playbook and the principles, then how, interrogate, verify-work, show-me-your-work, figure-it-out, reflect, correct and unslop do the steps. Adapted from Lauren Tan's pstack to work in any agent.
